label: Точка
description: A 10-sentence usage card for точка (point; dot).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Точка' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Красная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на карте' locates it.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Точку' is the accusative direct object of the imperative 'поставь'. 'В конце предложения' uses prepositional and genitive forms to locate it.
Strategic focus: Genitive after до. 'Точки' is the genitive after 'до' showing the endpoint reached. 'Нужной' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'дошли' is the verb.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В точке' uses the prepositional form 'точке' after 'в' to mark the spot. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional, and 'дороги' is genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Точке' is the dative after 'к' showing direction toward the point. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine dative, and 'линия' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after над. 'Точкой' is the instrumental after 'над' showing position above the dot. 'Круг' is the accusative object of 'нарисуй'.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Точка' is the nominative as the predicate noun. 'Самая высокая' is the superlative adjective, and 'горы' is the genitive showing of what.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after много. 'Точек' is the genitive plural with a fleeting vowel, required by 'много'. 'На небе' locates them, and 'видно' is impersonal.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. After 'две' the feminine noun takes the genitive singular 'точки'. 'Красные' agrees in the plural, and 'на графике' locates them.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Точки' is the inanimate accusative plural, identical to the nominative, as the object of 'соедини'. 'Все' agrees in the plural.
